|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on a battleground site. At same and adjacent sites: your Force generation is + 1, Imperials are forfeit + 1, Revolution is canceled, and cards may not have their deploy cost modified. Place Effect in Used Pile if this site is not a battleground or if it is controlled by an opponent.[Immune to Alter]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Security Precautions (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on a battleground site. At same and adjacent sites, your Force generation is +1, Revolution is canceled, and cards may not have their deploy cost modified. If this site is a non-battleground or you do not occupy this site, place this Effect in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “sites:” → “sites,”; “+ 1, Imperials are forfeit + 1,” → “+1,”; “Place” → “If this site is a non-battleground or you do not occupy this site, place this”; “Pile if this site is not a battleground or if it is controlled by an opponent.[Immune” → “Pile. (Immune”; “Alter]” → “Alter.)”.
